slides.text: some people feel like an extra coat on the hook: [[the flat never felt empty]] until you took it down.

caption:
the front hall looked twice as big the afternoon you loaded the car.
i still look at that bare peg when i unlock the door after six.
send this to the flatmate who always bought the big milk before the carton went empty.
alt: a small green donkey looking back over its shoulder beside words comparing an old roommate to an extra coat on the hook.
